unverifiedRequirements.label: Account Level 350+
unverifiedRequirements.description: Your Epic account must be at least level 350. Check your account level in-game.

unverifiedRequirements.label: Secure Boot
unverifiedRequirements.description: Secure Boot must be enabled in your PC's UEFI/BIOS. Blocks bootloader-level cheats.

unverifiedRequirements.label: TPM 2.0
unverifiedRequirements.description: A TPM 2.0 chip is required. Used by Epic's anti-cheat to verify system integrity.

unverifiedRequirements.label: IOMMU / VT-d
unverifiedRequirements.description: IOMMU must be enabled (Intel VT-d or AMD-Vi). Prevents direct-memory-access exploits.

unverifiedRequirements.label: Minimum iOS Version
unverifiedRequirements.description: Your iOS device must meet the minimum OS version required for security compliance.

unverifiedRequirements.label: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
unverifiedRequirements.description: 2FA must be enabled on your Epic account before entering this tournament.
